summary: Frontend scaffolding for Live List Checker UI (user/admin sections), types, styling utilities, and Admin/User page integration is present, but the diff summary does not show corresponding backend Motoko APIs/state, stable upgrade/migration handling, or full enforcement logic. Additionally, the Live List Checker status styling uses a blue theme for 'approved', conflicting with the 'no blue/purple primary theme' requirement.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend data models and APIs for name list upload/manage, claim creation with UPI ID, duplicate-claim prevention, claim status tracking (pending/approved/rejected), and admin claim review queries.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary shows only existing backend structures (comments/images/messages/etc.) and does not include any visible Live List Checker storage types or public methods (e.g., uploadNameList, createClaim, getAllClaims, approve/reject) in backend/main.mo; frontend types even note 'until backend implementation is complete'.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; no Live List Checker methods shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend support for admin-configurable limits and per-claim amount, enforcement of limits during claim creation, and totals query derived from claims.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls hooks for settings/totals, but the diff summary does not show backend storage or methods implementing settings, limit enforcement, or totals computation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend support for admin-managed public contact info (including WhatsApp number) with persistence across canister upgrades and user-facing query.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend UI/hook usage exists, but the diff summary does not show backend state or methods for setting/getting contact info, nor stable persistence handling.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; no contact info storage/methods shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend stable upgrade handling for new Live List Checker storage using backend/migration.mo (only if needed), preserving existing unrelated state.
missing_requirements.reason: No backend/migration.mo changes are shown in the diff summary, and backend/main.mo does not visibly include new stable variables or upgrade hooks for Live List Checker state.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; no stable upgrade logic for new LLC state shown)

hallucinated_features.description: UI theme includes a blue 'Approved' badge styling, conflicting with the requirement to avoid a blue/purple primary theme for the Live List Checker.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-8 explicitly says 'Do not use a blue/purple primary theme', but the statusStyles defines 'approved' as blue background/text.

hallucinated_features.description: Global primary color variables are still set to a purple hue (oklch ... 270) in index.css.
hallucinated_features.reason: While LLC-specific variables are added, the diff also shows --primary and --ring remain purple-toned; this is not requested as part of the Live List Checker theme work and may undermine the 'no blue/purple primary theme' intent if used by LLC components.
evidence: frontend/src/index.css (--primary: oklch(50% 0.2 270); --ring: oklch(50% 0.2 270); dark mode also uses 270)

hallucinated_features.description: Animated background performance/behavior optimizations and other unrelated UI refactors (e.g., ChatBox placeholder, adminPinSession session logic removal).
hallucinated_features.reason: These changes are described in the diff summary but are not part of the BuildRequest requirements for the Live List Checker feature.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (AnimatedBackground optimizations; ChatBox placeholder; adminPinSession session storage logic removed)
